verdict.rationale: Patent Center ships its own Training mode, an interactive simulation for safely practicing DOCX and PDF filings. That is a first-party sandbox-style environment kept apart from real submissions, not a dry-run of a live filing. Its scope is narrow: it is documented only for practice filing in the Patent Center UI, and nothing shows a programmatic or API sandbox for agents. missing for 10: an API-level sandbox or test environment for api.uspto.gov, documented separation from production data, sandbox coverage beyond Patent Center document filing (e.g. trademarks or payments), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Training mode is an interactive simulation where you can safely practice filing DOCX and PDF documents
